summary_ja: 適格BA―CVAヘッジ取引のヘッジ効果を反映する場合は完全なBA―CVA、反映しない場合は限定的なBA―CVAによる。
summary_en: A firm reflecting the hedging effect of eligible BA-CVA hedge transactions uses the full BA-CVA; one that does not uses the reduced BA-CVA.
paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that intends to calculate the CVA risk equivalent amount using the BA-CVA reflects the hedging effect of the eligible BA-CVA hedge transactions provided in the following Article, it shall use the method provided in Article 248-3-3 (referred to as the "full BA-CVA" in the following Article and Article 248-3-3, paragraph (1)); provided, however, that where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company does not reflect the hedging effect of CVA hedge transactions, it shall use the method provided in Article 248-3-4 (referred to as the "reduced BA-CVA" in that Article).
